text:
zoe-cs: FYI AvenueHealth just told us they're spinning up two new squads (ClinicalSearch + Intake) and usage jumped ~4x overnight. They asked about a predictable tail and a path to reserved capacity.
mike-ae: Renewal in ~10w. This looks like a clear expansion motion if we can nail SLAs and an onboarding playbook. Can eng estimate committed capacity and cost?
ana-eng: Suggest starting with 2 vGPUs dedicated with autoscale to 3 for sustained spikes. That should keep p95 embeddings <220ms for redwood/embed-v2. Need to confirm vector sizes and batch patterns.
lina-client: We're doing frequent bulk upserts (25k vectors/day) and live search with ~8k context summaries. Models: redwood/search-medium & embed-v2.
ops-bot: Monitor: avenue-prod embedding p95 = 260ms over last 15m, error_rate 0.6% (rate-limiter events).
ana-eng: 260ms p95 is high. Short-term: enable prefix caching and smaller RT batch window; medium-term: reserve dedicated pool and enable async client batching. I'll open infra ticket (infra/avenue/dedicated).
raj-support: I'll prepare a customer runbook and two client snippets for async upserts. Sample: 
```bash
# async upsert example
node upsert.js --batch 64 --concurrency 4
```
zoo-cs: (typo) zoe-cs: Added: they want a 60-min tech workshop + two office hours for their SREs. Lina, does next Wed 11am ET work?
lina-client: Works for us. We'll also share a 1.2GB test corpus by EOD.
mike-ae: Ballpark pricing: 2 reserved vGPUs + burst to 3 ~ $9k/mo delta. Recommend offering a 15% pilot credit for first quarter.
zoe-cs: I'll add this to the renewal tracker as high-opportunity and draft the proposal. Next: Mike to send pricing, Ana to open infra ticket + perf plan, Raj to draft runbook, Lina to upload test data and confirm workshop time.
mike-ae: I'll send a pricing email by EOD tomorrow.
ana-eng: Opening infra ticket now and will include cache TTLs, autoscale thresholds, and quantization notes for long contexts.
raj-support: Runbook draft incoming in 24h.
lina-client: Upload done, link sent to the shared folder. Thanks everyone.
